articles.summary: On September 12, 2025, the EU Data Act becomes fully applicable across the EU. For the energy industry, this marks a turning point in how data flows across devices, services, and users.
articles.title: The EU Data Act: What the energy industry needs to know before September 12

articles.summary: Sense is on a mission to make homes smarter and more energy aware. Their software, embedded in next-generation smart meters, translates raw electrical signals into real-time insights, helping consumers understand exactly how energy is being used in their home, device by device. Now, with the launch of EV Analytics, Sense is bringing that intelligence to one of the fastest-growing parts of the home: electric vehicles. EV Analytics helps households understand charging behavior, optimize costs, and prepare for the future of smart charging. To make it possible, Sense partnered with Enode.
articles.title: How Sense is unlocking real-time energy insights for every home

articles.summary: Resideo Grid Services, a leading smart-home energy management provider in North America, and partner Enode will help utilities unlock more value from residential demand flexibility. The collaboration makes it easier to launch and scale programs that connect a wider range of home energy devices—including batteries, solar inverters, and EV chargers—while enabling homeowners to participate directly through their utility or energy provider’s existing platform. Together, Resideo Grid Services and Enode are making residential flexibility more accessible, impactful, and scalable than ever before.
articles.title: Resideo Grid Services and Enode expand access to residential energy flexibility

articles.summary: Fuse is the fastest growing energy retailer in the UK for a reason. They offer some of the most competitive fixed and time-of-use (ToU) tariffs on the market, alongside a seamless switching experience through the Fuse app and web. Now, Fuse is partnering with Enode to take that experience even further, bringing intelligent EV charging and public charging features to EV owners across the UK.
articles.title: Fuse Energy delivers super cheap EV charging with Enode
